notes.title: Celebrating Two Years of The Cursed Amulet!
notes.content: [p]Time flies! It’s been [b]two whole years[/b] since [i]The Cursed Amulet[/i] launched on Steam, and we’re beyond grateful for everyone who joined us on this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’re opening the vault and sharing a few [b]beta renders[/b] — early glimpses into the game’s world during development. These behind-the-scenes images show how far things have come and remind us how it all began.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to share that we’re [b]hard at work on a brand-new project[/b] — something totally different, built in [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b]. It's not a sequel just yet… but it's helping us sharpen our skills and tools so we can return to [i]The Cursed Amulet[/i] with even more experience and ambition.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/f493bf4bc39faf4b1a9d9cdd066110be92f0e0f7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/7deb1df2659fd34cec07e13597f5462e39f41022.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/04ba1e38b367c17007e73a6254ce3a75e2e25ae2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/1baad5ed3c8f268ea50889b8842c991818464a97.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/02d60a1b77430af1e307b26dd58537f8dfdb3cb4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/80221a7ea48f849b9b6dc0eddfcd04dc6776e6e3.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Thank you for sticking with us for two amazing years. Here's to many more adventures ahead![/p]

notes.title: Celebrating One Year of The Cursed Amulet!
notes.content:
It's hard to believe that a whole year has passed since we launched The Cursed Amulet. To celebrate this milestone, we've created a special anniversary trailer showcasing everything we've accomplished over the past year. But that's not all! As a bonus, we're giving you a sneak peek at some exciting new content we've been working on.

[previewyoutube=KYf33a98AYE;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for an incredible year we can't wait to share more adventures with you in the future!

notes.title: The Cursed Amulet - Update 1.4
notes.content:
[b]The Cursed Amulet has been updated to a new version, which includes additional translations and minor bug fixes.[/b]

Improvements and changes:
[list]
[*] Added Czech translation.
[*] Added Greek translation.
[*] Added Hungarian translation.
[*] Improved textures for "The Amulets Challenge" puzzle.
[*] Changed the first part of "The Amulets Challenge" puzzle so that the selected parts of the contraption light up when hovered over.
[*] Some minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list]
We hope that you continue enjoying The Cursed Amulet even more after these improvements!

Please nominate The Cursed Amulet for the [b]Sit Back and Relax[/b] category! We hope we can count on your vote.

notes.title: The Cursed Amulet - Update 1.2
notes.content:
[b]The Cursed Amulet has been updated to a new version, which includes additional translations, a brand-new manual and bug fixes.[/b]

Improvements and changes:
[list]
[*] Added Azerbaijani translation done by [url=https://linktr.ee/alishikhalizada]Ali Shikhalizada[/url].
[*] Added Thai translation.
[*] Added Vietnamese translation.
[*] Added a brand-new game manual.
[*] Fixed a bug that activated the levers while the emitter is rotating allowing you to speed up the animation in the "Rays and Symbols" level.
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent the achievement "Treasure Found" from being granted.
[*] Changed the height of the pillars in the "Fountain of Glory" level to make reaching the next level easier.
[/list]
We hope that you continue enjoying The Cursed Amulet even more after these improvements!

notes.title: The Cursed Amulet - Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]The Cursed Amulet has been updated to a new version, fixing some issues with lighting and bugs.[/b]

Improvements and changes:
[list]
[*] Added more crystals to the "Steep Falls" level to improve the lighting.
[*] Added stronger lights to the crystal indicators in the "Traps" level to better indicate which crystal indicator is glowing.
[*] Added Russian translation done by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198158864042]Berry[/url]
[*] Fixed a lighting error that caused the last pillar to be hidden in pitch black darkness in "The Amulets Challenge" level.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the incorrect selected symbols go deeper in the wall after pulling the lever in "The Amulets Challenge" level.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the rotating pedestals to rotate more than needed by moving left and right when the laser makes first contact with the crystal symbol of the pedestal in the "Rays and Symbols" level. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to always select the highest resolution when entering the "Graphics options" menu in windowed mode.
[*] Changed the small crystal's position in the "Cave Entrance" level to make it more noticeable.
[*] Changed the last part of the "The Amulets Challenge" level so that the crystals on the pillars now illuminate when the final part of the puzzle is reached.
[*] Changed the "Crystal Memory" puzzle to make the puzzle start from the beginning of the new combination after making a mistake.
[/list]
We hope that you continue enjoying The Cursed Amulet even more after these changes!

notes.title: THE CURSED AMULET IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047595/961ebd173ea3b44e1919f051f01894e107ecd67e.png[/img]
The Cursed Amulet, is out now on Steam for PC players all over the world!

[h1]About The Cursed Amulet[/h1]

The Cursed Amulet is an immersive puzzle adventure escape room game.

In this single player game, you play as a curious adventurer who finds themselves trapped in a mysterious cave full of puzzles and hidden secrets. Your mission is to solve the puzzles, unravel the mysteries, and ultimately escape the cave before it's too late.

Challenge your mind with eight unique and exciting puzzles that will keep you engaged and entertained throughout the game.

Immerse yourself in a mysterious and ambient atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.
